name: jev-decisions
description: Ask TypeSafe Jev for fast probabilistic decisions from local Codex and ChatGPT tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Fast probabilistic decisions with TypeSafe Jev.
interface.longDescription: Adds local Jev tools for binary probabilities, categorical choices, rubric scores, and batched mixed decisions. Selected context is sent to TypeSafe's API.
defaultPrompt: Use Jev to decide whether this evidence supports the claim.
Ask Jev to classify these items into my categories.
Use Jev to score these options against my rubric.
